summary:
Planet X Hunter is an AI-powered platform designed to support the exploration and analysis of astronomical data related to NASA’s SPHEREx mission. The project addresses the challenge of analyzing massive amounts of astronomical observations to identify unusual patterns and potential moving celestial objects that may be candidates for further investigation.

Our platform combines astronomical image analysis, AI-assisted pattern detection, observation comparison, and interactive data visualization in one accessible environment. It aims to help researchers identify interesting objects, explore changes across observations, and prioritize promising candidates for further scientific study.

By making astronomical data exploration more organized and accessible, Planet X Hunter demonstrates how artificial intelligence can support space research and contribute to our understanding of the universe.
details:
Planet X Hunter is an AI-assisted astronomical exploration platform developed to support the analysis of astronomical data and observations related to NASA's SPHEREx mission.

The project aims to address the challenge of identifying unusual celestial objects within massive astronomical datasets. It provides an interactive environment where users can explore astronomical images, analyze observations, identify unusual patterns, and compare available data to investigate potential changes over time.

The platform follows a structured workflow that includes data input, data processing, AI-assisted analysis, observation comparison, and interactive visualization. Its purpose is to help users identify interesting astronomical candidates and make complex data easier to explore and understand.

We developed the application using Python, with Streamlit to build the interactive web interface and supporting Python libraries for data processing, analysis, and visualization.

What makes Planet X Hunter creative is its combination of astronomical exploration, artificial intelligence, and interactive visualization in one platform. Instead of simply displaying astronomical data, it aims to transform observations into meaningful insights that can support further scientific investigation.

The intended impact is to make astronomical data exploration more accessible, organized, and efficient, while encouraging interest in space science and the search for potential Planet X candidates.

Planet X Hunter is designed as a research-support tool, not as a system that independently confirms the discovery of a new planet.
